strategic_architecture: 'Rog-Thras' - competitive Simic-tempo storm deck with a red splash via the free (0-cost) Rograkh partner. Rograkh accelerates mana/interaction from turn one; Thrasios converts excess mana into card draw and serves as an infinite-mana outlet. Distinct game plan from this project's subject deck despite sharing Thrasios: Rog-Thras is turbo-storm-leaning (win turns 1-4 via combo assembly), while the subject deck (Thrasios/Tymna 'Tree-Farm') is a slower, creature-synergy midrange deck. Confirms per charter Phase 8 that shared-commander pairings can be genuinely different archetypes, not just flex-slot variance. Sources: Commander's Herald 'An Introduction to Rograkh's Bouncy House', Hipsters of the Coast primer, EDHREC.
